_comment: Sample input/output pair for LandscapePlacementAgent (knowledge_landscape_design.md §7.3 + category_gap_candidates_design.md §5.1). Not consumed by production code; human reference + fixture source for tests. All ids are already resolved into text by core/landscape/builder.py before the agent sees them, and every node_id below exists in the supplied domains (the validator rejects invented anchors). The optional category_gaps section carries *candidate* categories only: it never moves the map, and a malformed candidate drops itself without costing a placement (warning-only soft collector).

input.paper_title: A consistency relation for the cosmic microwave background lensing amplitude
input.central_question: Can the lensing amplitude measured from temperature and polarization be described by a single consistency relation?
input.central_thesis: A single consistency relation links the temperature and polarization lensing amplitudes within the quoted precision.
input.paper_goal: Establish a consistency relation between the two measured lensing amplitudes.
input.headline_claim: The two lensing amplitudes agree once the same beam model is used.

claim_summaries.text: The reconstructed lensing power spectrum is measured over the multipole range 100 < L < 2000.
A quadratic estimator is applied to the foreground-cleaned temperature maps.
The inferred amplitude constrains the sum of the neutrino masses.
